mainEntity.name: What is Origin Evaporation in AI-mediated knowledge and how can origin survive regeneration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Origin Evaporation describes the loss of identifiable intellectual or structural origin when ideas are summarized, recombined, or regenerated while remaining semantically usable. In Nakagawa Master's Structural Origin Defense framework, Permanent Signature is presented as a provenance-continuity pattern intended to keep the originating theory, canonical source, and revision identity recoverable across transformation.
